family_rule: Use separate ontology identities for product meaning, capability meaning, authority, generated runtime structure, architecture constraints, and evidence-bearing alignment. Use views inside one system ontology for tightly coupled runtime concerns.

ontologies.label: Essays Product Ontology
ontologies.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
ontologies.purpose: Own the writer, product journey, writing artifacts, lifecycle, review, residue, export boundary, value mechanism, and product exclusions.
ontologies.entry_gate: Exact product thesis and first-user journey selected for review.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Frozen candidate package with closed sources, nodes, relations, views, residue, schema, and deterministic validation; owner approval is deferred to the exact pre-merge candidate.

ontologies.label: Whisper-Derived Writing Capability Ontology
ontologies.purpose: Own intent capture, composition planning, drafting, addressable feedback, explicit revision decisions, validation, residue, and clean export as product-facing capability meaning.
ontologies.entry_gate: Product ontology has stable IDs for the first-user journey and artifacts.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Capability contracts bind each lifecycle transition without importing Whisper implementation authority.

ontologies.label: Multi-Client Agent Runtime Capability Ontology
ontologies.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus CyberAlchemy v2 product owner
ontologies.purpose: Own multi-client continuity, proposal custody, browser evidence, command receipts, revisions, recovery, transport non-authority, and capability-bounded extensions.
ontologies.entry_gate: Existing FLAG package remains byte-bound while its dependent capability records are refreshed against their adopted contracts.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Structurally closed candidate plus complete input, output, context-policy, obligation, and realization-precondition records; owner approval is deferred to pre-merge.

ontologies.label: Agent And External-Effect Authority Ontology
ontologies.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus security owner plus owner of each external effect
ontologies.purpose: Own actor identity, grants, proposals, acceptance, rejection, revocation, browser action requests, effect envelopes, credentials, uncertainty, and the non-collapse between authentication and authority.
ontologies.entry_gate: Business capabilities and external-effect exclusions have stable identifiers.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Every mutable or external action maps to an explicit owner, grant, scope, expiry, revocation, receipt, and failure posture.

ontologies.label: Agent Runtime Architecture Property Ontology
ontologies.owner_route: Essays runtime owner plus independent conformance owner
ontologies.purpose: Define checkable invariants before code: one semantic transition authority, deterministic reducers, expected revisions, durable-before-ack, idempotent command handling, transport parity, default-deny capabilities, explicit effect uncertainty, bounded resources, adapter replaceability, and versioned extension interfaces.
ontologies.entry_gate: Business and authority rules are stable enough to translate into falsifiable properties.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Every property has subject types, value domain, constraint operator, observation stage, negative fixture, and owner route.

ontologies.label: Generated Essays Agent Runtime System Ontology
ontologies.owner_route: DomainSpec v2 owner plus Essays runtime owner
ontologies.purpose: Describe the exact generated runtime components, ports, commands, events, state, schemas, persistence, client protocols, agents, browser supervision, security enforcement, telemetry, deployment units, tests, and runtime constraints.
ontologies.entry_gate: Candidate DomainSpec source binds exact structurally validated business, authority, capability-contract, and architecture-property digests.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Two clean compiler runs produce byte-identical graph and system ontology with no unresolved selected dependency.

ontologies.label: Essays Runtime Realization And Conformance Bridge
ontologies.owner_route: Essays Project owner plus independent conformance owner
ontologies.purpose: Bind each business outcome, rule, policy, and capability obligation to generated system artifacts, implementation bytes, tests, telemetry, browser evidence, and explicit drift or evidence gaps.
ontologies.entry_gate: Exact generated system ontology, implementation digest, tests, telemetry, and runtime receipts exist.
ontologies.exit_evidence: Every promoted business rule has realized_by plus tested_by or an explicit evidence gap; alignment claims cite both branches and exact implementation evidence.

system_view_rule: Data, client protocol, persistence, agents, browser control, security enforcement, observability, and deployment are views inside the one generated system ontology because they share command, identity, revision, event, and receipt IDs. Splitting them into independent ontologies would invite semantic drift.
